utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs sorting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can help sort tools or make a quick list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane — could you make that quick list and I’ll sort the tools? That’ll help us keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive — what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — can you first confirm the exact address and what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — send me the exact address and start time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supply bins for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s running low, and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if I spot anything running low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll check the bins and keep a list ready. Just send me updates when you see something low.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive — what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you — we still need to sort the pickup list and confirm who can bring tools. I’m just worried about timing and whether we’ll have enough hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the pickup list and start checking who can bring tools. If you want, I’ll also ask around about timing so we can see where the gaps are.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’m still in — I just need the latest details since I’m hearing things secondhand. What time and where should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re meeting at 3 by the community shed, then we’ll head out together. Just bring gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing in all kinds of fixes this week—pretty good turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been a nice turnout. I’ve got a few tools here too, so if anybody needs a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s sweet of you, Gus—people will really appreciate the extra hands. I’ll spread the word that you’re here if anyone gets stuck!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone—I can send over the details and see who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please send me the details too, and I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and start a list of who’s bringing what so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re free on Saturday, and maybe bring a drill if you have one?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m free on Saturday, and I can bring a drill if I have one. I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m happy to coordinate the next steps with you, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Rosa — just send me the list and I’ll take a quick look. I can help with the next steps once I see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send it over right away, Bo, and then we can sort out the next steps together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to bring a few tools by the repair drive later, and I’ll check with the others to see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep my usual toolbox ready just in case.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll swing by later, check what’s left, and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I knew I was forgetting something. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a pair of work gloves and maybe a screwdriver, if you’ve got one. Thank you, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can bring those. If I forget the screwdriver, just remind me when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and see who’s willing to donate tools or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask around for tools and extra hands. I’ll let you know who’s in!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive’s coming up soon — I’m putting the word out to everyone on the block. You in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, count me in — I’ll swing by late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Dane — I’ll save you a spot. Even late help will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still taking it in, honestly—what needs fixing most for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: First thing, I’d say the brakes and the tires—those are the ones I’d want checked before anything else. Then we can make a simple list and go through it one by one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — brakes and tires first, then we can build the list from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need to know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send you the repair drive time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — once you have the time, I’ll work it around pickup and let you know what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — could you help spread the word and ask folks to bring tools or spare parts? I’ll keep you posted on the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask people to bring any tools or spare parts they can spare. Keep me posted, and I’ll pass along the next update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Pia — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I’m just trying to make sure we don’t end up short on anything, so I’ll check what’s already covered and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll keep my tools set aside in the meantime. Just send me the list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Opal—thank you. Please let me know the exact spot, and I’ll make sure everyone has it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll check and tell you the exact spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for Saturday? I can bring tools if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for Saturday. I’ll double-check what tools are needed and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — just let me know what to bring. I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me keep track of what supplies we still need and what’s already been promised?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep a running list of needed supplies and what’s already promised. Just send me any updates, and I’ll track it for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the details yet — what’s the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, it’s for fixing up a few things around the neighborhood—small repairs, I think. I might’ve missed part of the details, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the specifics. If you hear more, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is this the repair drive you mentioned? I want to make sure I’ve got the right one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one — the repair drive over by the community center. If you want, I can send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please send the details so I can double-check I’m looking at the right one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to ask you about that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly sorting donations and checking what still needs fixing. I can help with either if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I’d really appreciate that. Let’s start with sorting the donations, and then we can check what still needs fixing.
